On |a|<=lambda/2 and B<=lambda/2, [a-B,a+B] lies within the potential interval; its length 2B and integrand >=2^-p B^-p give 2^-p B^(1-p)/lambda. No neighbor independence is used.

reproduction: For each L, the iid event on a fixed L-cube has probability p_L^(L^d)>0. Pairwise disjoint translates give independent Bernoulli trials, so infinitely many successful cubes occur almost surely; countable intersection covers all L. For any E in the free band choose a Fourier wave vector k with -2 sum cos(k_j)=E. Each one-coordinate shift of the normalized cutoff plane wave has defect norm sqrt(2/L); summing 2d defects gives 2d sqrt(2/L). The potential defect is <=1/L on a successful cube.
scope: Auxiliary Weyl-sequence construction on a common probability-one event; spectral type not determined.
unresolved_gap: No absolutely continuous component or GOE statistic follows.
independence: Recomputed cube event and cutoff defect without using the claimed norm conclusion.

reproduction: With r=(H0-E)psi and a=(E-z)^(-1)=i/eta, the exact equation R0 psi-a psi=-a R0 r gives residual ||(K-b)psi||<=lambda M||r||/eta^2+lambda/(eta L) tending to zero for b=lambda m a, |m|=M. Thus |b|=c=lambda M/eta belongs to sigma(K), while ||K||<=c, yielding r(K)=||K||=c. The telescoping identity makes K^n psi approximate b^n psi for each fixed n, so ||K^n||=c^n. Applying R0 and using R0 psi->a psi gives ||R0K^n||=c^n/eta. Therefore Neumann terms fail the necessary term-to-zero condition at c>=1 and converge geometrically at c<1.

fixed_statement: For free nearest-neighbor adjacency on Z^3, every spectral measure is absolutely continuous. For periodic odd-L boxes and any fixed nondegenerate energy interval I with closure inside (-6,6), the number M_L of box eigenvalues in I tends to infinity and at least M_L/2 adjacent gaps among the sorted levels in I are zero. Hence infinite-volume a.c. alone does not imply GOE bulk local statistics. This is a lambda=0 auxiliary counterexample only.
reproduction: Fourier transform gives multiplication by h(theta)=2 sum cos(theta_j). Its gradient is nonzero off eight Haar-null points, so null energy sets have null preimage and all weighted spectral measures are a.c. For odd L, k->-k has only fixed point k=0 at energy 6 outside I; all I-momenta pair, giving at most M_L/2 distinct energies and at least M_L/2 zero gaps. A nondegenerate I has open positive-measure preimage; boundary energy levels have Haar-null preimage, so M_L/L^3 approaches a positive measure. Strictly monotone unfolding preserves zero gaps.
why_fix: The author's phrase 'nonempty interval' also permits a singleton under a literal reading; then M_L need not diverge. Require nondegenerate or nonempty interior.
unresolved_gap: No conclusion for any fixed positive disorder or nonperiodic finite-volume convention.
independence: Independently checked Fourier null-set argument and odd-torus momentum orbits.
